description: Lets invited workers with skills Australia needs live and work permanently anywhere in Australia. For skilled workers who are not sponsored by an employer, state or family member.
description_tr: Avustralya'nın gerekli gördüğü becerilere sahip davetli çalışanların Avustralya'nın her yerinde kalıcı olarak yaşamasına ve çalışmasına izin verir. İşveren, eyalet veya aile tarafından desteklenmeyen yetenekli çalışanlar için.
description_zh: 允许拥有澳大利亚所需技能并获得邀请的工人在澳大利亚任何地方永久生活和工作。适用于未获雇主、州或家庭担保的技术工人。
requirements_zh: 职业须在技术职业清单上
steps: Check your occupation is on MLTSSL

name: Skilled Nominated visa
description: For skilled workers nominated by a state or territory government.
description_tr: Eyalet veya bölge hükümeti tarafından aday gösterilen yetenekli çalışanlar için.
description_zh: 适用于获得州或地区政府提名的技术工人。
requirements_tr: Meslek MLTSSL veya STSOL listesinde olmalı
Eyalet veya bölge adaylığı (5 puan ekler)

name: Skilled Work Regional visa
description: For skilled workers nominated by a state or sponsored by family to live and work in regional Australia.
description_tr: Avustralya'nın bölgesel alanlarında yaşamak ve çalışmak isteyen yetenekli çalışanlar için.
description_zh: 适用于希望在澳大利亚偏远地区生活和工作的技术工人。
requirements: Occupation on MLTSSL, STSOL or ROL
State nomination or family sponsorship (adds 15 points)
Must live and work in regional Australia
requirements_tr: Meslek MLTSSL, STSOL veya ROL listesinde olmalı
Eyalet adaylığı veya aile sponsorluğu (15 puan ekler)
Avustralya'nın bölgesel alanlarında yaşanmalı ve çalışılmalı
requirements_zh: 州提名或家庭担保（加15分）
必须在澳大利亚偏远地区生活和工作
steps: Apply for state nomination or family sponsorship
Live in regional area for 3 years to apply for PR (191 visa)
steps_tr: Eyalet adaylığı veya aile sponsorluğu için başvurun
PR (191 vizesi) için 3 yıl bölgesel alanda yaşayın
steps_zh: 申请州提名或家庭担保
在偏远地区生活3年后可申请191永居签证

name: Skills in Demand visa
type: Temporary (up to 4 years; up to 5 for some Hong Kong passport holders)
description: Employer‑sponsored temporary visa for skilled workers. Stay up to 4 years (up to 5 for eligible Hong Kong passport holders). Fees and processing times vary; consult the Home Affairs visa page and processing time guide.
description_tr: Yetenekli çalışanlar için işveren destekli geçici vize.
description_zh: 雇主担保的技术工人临时签证。

name: Temporary Graduate visa - Post-Higher Education Work
name_tr: Geçici Mezun Vizesi - Yüksek Öğretim Sonrası Çalışma
name_zh: 临时毕业生签证 - 高等教育后工作通道
description: Stay 2-6 years after completing Australian studies. Work and live temporarily in Australia; up to 5 years for Hong Kong and British National Overseas passport holders. Must find own employment.
description_tr: Avustralya'da eğitim tamamladıktan sonra 2-6 yıl kalın. Avustralya'da geçici olarak çalışın ve yaşayın; Hong Kong ve British National Overseas pasaport sahipleri 5 yıla kadar kalabilir. Kendi istihdam bulmanız gerekir.
description_zh: 完成澳大利亚学业后停留2-6年。在澳大利亚临时工作和生活；香港和英国国民（海外）护照持有者可停留至5年。必须自己寻找工作。
requirements: Completed eligible Australian degree (Bachelor, Masters, or Doctorate)
Applied within 6 months of course completion
Under 50 years of age when applying (under 35 normally, but exceptions for higher qualifications and certain passport holders)
requirements_tr: Uygun Avustralya derecesini tamamlamış (Lisans, Yüksek Lisans veya Doktora)
Kurs bitişinden sonra 6 ay içinde başvurmuş
Başvuru yaparken 50 yaş altında (normalde 35 yaş altında, ancak daha yüksek nitelikler ve belirli pasaport sahipleri için istisnalar)
requirements_zh: 完成符合条件的澳大利亚学位（学士学位、硕士或博士）
在课程完成后6个月内申请
申请时年满50岁以下（通常为35岁以下，但高学历和特定护照持有人除外）
澳大利亚联邦警察品格检查
steps: Get confirmation of course completion from your education provider
Check your age and qualifications meet requirements
Apply for Australian Federal Police character check (do this before visa application)
Lodge visa application online in ImmiAccount within 6 months of graduation
Pay visa application charge (AUD 4,600 main applicant, lower cost for eligible Pacific Island and Timor-Leste citizens from March 1, 2026)
Provide all required documents and evidence
steps_tr: Eğitim sağlayıcınızdan kurs tamamlanması onayını alın
Yaşınızın ve niteliklerinizin şartları karşılayıp karşılamadığını kontrol edin
Avustralya Federal Polis karakter kontrolü için başvurun (vize başvurusundan önce yapın)
İmmiAccount'da çevrimiçi vize başvurusu yapın (mezuniyetten sonra 6 ay içinde)
Vize başvuru ücretini ödeyin (ana başvurucu için AUD 4.600, 1 Mart 2026'dan itibaren uygun Pasifik Adası ve Timor-Leste vatandaşları için daha düşük maliyet)
Tüm gerekli belge ve kanıtları sağlayın
steps_zh: 从教育机构获得课程完成确认
检查您的年龄和资格是否符合要求
安排体检（可能需要时间）
申请澳大利亚联邦警察品格检查（在签证申请前进行）
在毕业后6个月内通过ImmiAccount在线提交签证申请
支付签证申请费（主申请人澳元4,600，从2026年3月1日起，符合条件的太平洋岛国和东帝汶公民收费更低）
提供所有必需的文件和证据

description: Lets the de facto partner or spouse of an Australian citizen, permanent resident or eligible NZ citizen live in Australia temporarily. The first step toward the permanent Partner visa (subclass 801).
description_tr: Avustralya vatandaşı, daimi oturma izni sahibi veya uygun bir Yeni Zelanda vatandaşının de facto partnerinin veya eşinin Avustralya'da geçici olarak yaşamasına izin verir. Kalıcı Partner Vizesi'ne (subclass 801) ilk adımdır.
description_zh: 允许澳大利亚公民、永久居民或符合条件的新西兰公民的事实伴侣或配偶在澳大利亚临时居住。这是获得永久配偶签证（801类别）的第一步。
requirements: In a genuine relationship (married or de facto) with an Australian citizen, permanent resident, or eligible NZ citizen
Sponsored by that partner (sponsorship must be approved)
Must be in Australia when you apply; family members applying with you must also be in Australia
No outstanding debt to the Australian Government
requirements_tr: Avustralya vatandaşı, daimi oturma izni sahibi veya uygun bir Yeni Zelanda vatandaşıyla gerçek bir ilişki (evlilik veya de facto) içinde olmak
O partner tarafından sponsor olunmak (sponsorluk onaylanmış olmalı)
Başvuru sırasında Avustralya'da olmak; sizinle başvuran aile üyeleri de Avustralya'da olmalı
requirements_zh: 与澳大利亚公民、永久居民或符合条件的新西兰公民存在真实关系（婚姻或事实关系）
由该伴侣担保（担保必须获得批准）
申请时必须在澳大利亚境内；随同申请的家庭成员也必须在澳大利亚境内
对澳大利亚政府无未偿还债务
签署澳大利亚价值观声明
steps: Gather relationship evidence (relationship history, financial, household, social, and commitment evidence)
Sponsor lodges the 'Sponsorship for a Partner to Migrate to Australia' form
Lodge your subclass 820 application online via ImmiAccount while in Australia
Complete health examinations and provide character/police documents
Receive a Bridging visa A (BVA) if your current substantive visa expires first
Wait for a decision — processing times vary; check the official visa processing time guide tool
If granted, you hold subclass 820 until your permanent Partner visa (subclass 801) is finalised
steps_tr: İlişki kanıtlarını toplayın (ilişki geçmişi, mali, ev içi, sosyal ve bağlılık kanıtları)
Sponsor 'Sponsorship for a Partner to Migrate to Australia' formunu gönderir
Avustralya'dayken ImmiAccount üzerinden subclass 820 başvurunuzu yapın
Sağlık muayenelerini tamamlayın ve karakter/polis belgelerini sağlayın
Mevcut geçerli vizeniz daha önce sona ererse Bridging visa A (BVA) alırsınız
Karar için bekleyin — işlem süreleri değişkendir; resmi vize işlem süresi rehber aracını kontrol edin
Onaylanırsa, kalıcı Partner Vizesi (subclass 801) sonuçlanana kadar subclass 820 tutarsınız
steps_zh: 收集关系证据（关系历史、财务、家庭、社会及承诺证据）
担保人提交'担保伴侣移民澳大利亚'表格
在澳大利亚境内通过ImmiAccount提交820类别申请
完成体检并提供品格/警方证明文件
如果您当前的实质性签证先到期，您将获得过桥签证A（BVA）
等待结果——处理时间不固定；请查阅官方签证处理时间指南工具
获批后，您将持有820类别签证，直至永久配偶签证（801类别）最终确定

name: Partner visa (Permanent)
description: Permanent residence for partners or spouses of Australian citizens or permanent residents, granted after holding a subclass 820 (or 445) visa. You become eligible for assessment 2 years after you first applied for the temporary and permanent Partner visas.
description_tr: Avustralyalı vatandaş veya daimi oturma izni sahibi kişilerin partnerleri için, subclass 820 (veya 445) vizesini taşıdıktan sonra verilen daimi oturma izni. Geçici ve kalıcı Partner Vizesi için ilk başvurduğunuzdan 2 yıl sonra değerlendirmeye uygun hale gelirsiniz.
description_zh: 为澳大利亚公民或永久居民的配偶或伴侣提供永久居留权，在持有820类别（或445类别）签证后授予。自您首次申请临时及永久配偶签证之日起2年后，您将具备评估资格。
requirements: Hold a temporary Partner visa (subclass 820) or Dependent Child visa (subclass 445)
2 years must have passed since you applied for the subclass 820 and 801 visas (may be waived for long-term relationships)
Continue to be the spouse or de facto partner of the same person who sponsored your subclass 820 visa
Continue to meet health and character requirements
No outstanding debt to the Australian Government
requirements_tr: Geçici Partner Vizesi (subclass 820) veya Dependent Child vizesi (subclass 445) tutmak
Subclass 820 ve 801 başvurusu yapmanızdan itibaren 2 yıl geçmiş olmalı (uzun süreli ilişkilerde muaf olabilir)
Subclass 820 vizenizi sponsor eden kişiyle eş veya de facto partner olarak ilişkinize devam etmeniz
Sağlık ve karakter gereksinimlerini karşılamaya devam etmek
requirements_zh: 持有临时配偶签证（820类别）或受抚养子女签证（445类别）
自您申请820和801类别签证以来必须已过2年（长期关系可能获得豁免）
继续与担保您820类别签证的同一人保持配偶或事实伴侣关系
继续符合健康和品格要求
对澳大利亚政府无未偿还债务
steps: Become eligible for assessment 2 years after you first applied (check your application date in ImmiAccount)
Provide updated relationship evidence (statutory declaration from sponsor, financial/household/social/commitment evidence)
Provide an updated Australian police certificate if your previous one has expired
Submit your Stage 2 - Permanent Partner Visa Assessment via ImmiAccount
Wait for a decision — processing times vary; check the official visa processing time guide tool
If granted, you become a permanent resident from the day the visa is granted
steps_tr: İlk başvurunuzdan 2 yıl sonra değerlendirmeye uygun hale gelirsiniz (başvuru tarihinizi ImmiAccount'tan kontrol edin)
Güncellenmiş ilişki kanıtları sağlayın (sponsordan yeminli beyan, mali/ev içi/sosyal/bağlılık kanıtları)
Önceki polis belgeniz süresi dolmuşsa güncellenmiş bir Avustralya polis belgesi sağlayın
ImmiAccount üzerinden Stage 2 - Permanent Partner Visa Assessment başvurunuzu gönderin
Karar için bekleyin — işlem süreleri değişkendir; resmi vize işlem süresi rehber aracını kontrol edin
Onaylanırsa, vizenin verildiği günden itibaren daimi oturma izni sahibi olursunuz
steps_zh: 自首次申请之日起2年后具备评估资格（请在ImmiAccount中查看您的申请日期）
提供更新的关系证据（担保人法定声明、财务/家庭/社会/承诺证据）
如先前的警方证明已过期，请提供更新的澳大利亚警方证明
通过ImmiAccount提交第二阶段——永久配偶签证评估申请
等待结果——处理时间不固定；请查阅官方签证处理时间指南工具
获批后，您将自签证授予之日起成为永久居民

name: Express Entry Canada
name_zh: 加拿大快速通道 Express Entry
description: Canada's primary immigration system for skilled workers seeking permanent residency, utilizing the Comprehensive Ranking System (CRS). Covers FSWP, CEC, and FSTP.
description_tr: Kanada'nın nitelikli göçmenler için uyguladığı, Kapsamlı Sıralama Sistemi (CRS) puan tabanlı daimi oturum (PR) sistemidir. FSWP, CEC ve FSTP programlarını yönetir.
description_zh: 加拿大针对寻求永久居民身份的技术工人的主要移民系统，包括 FSWP、CEC 和 FSTP，采用综合排名系统（CRS）进行筛选。
requirements: Meet eligibility for Federal Skilled Worker, Skilled Trades, or Canadian Experience Class
Language test results (CLB 7 minimum for FSWP/CEC TEER 0-1, CLB 5 for TEER 2-3)
Educational Credential Assessment (ECA) for foreign degrees (FSWP requirement)
Proof of funds (unless authorized to work or have a valid job offer)
No criminal record (police certificate) and clean health assessment
requirements_tr: Federal Skilled Worker, Skilled Trades veya Canadian Experience Class şartlarını karşılamak
Dil sınavı sonuçları (FSWP/CEC TEER 0-1 için en az CLB 7, TEER 2-3 için CLB 5)
Yabancı diplomalar için Eğitim Denklik Değerlendirmesi (ECA) (FSWP için zorunlu)
Yeterli finansal birikim kanıtı (iş teklifi veya Kanada'da çalışma izni yoksa)
Adli sicil kaydı olmaması (polis sertifikası) ve sağlık muayenesi onayı
requirements_zh: 满足联邦技术移民（FSWP）、联邦技工移民（FSTP）或加拿大经验类移民（CEC）的要求
语言测试成绩（FSWP/CEC TEER 0-1 至少达到 CLB 7，TEER 2-3 达到 CLB 5）
非加拿大学历的学历认证（ECA，FSWP 必须）
资金证明（获得工作授权或有效工作聘书除外）
无犯罪记录（警方证明）且体检合格
steps: Find your NOC code (National Occupational Classification)
Take your language test (IELTS, CELPIP or PTE Core)
Get your foreign education credentials assessed (ECA)
Calculate your CRS (Comprehensive Ranking System) score
Submit your Express Entry profile to the pool
Wait for an Invitation to Apply (ITA)
Submit your complete PR application within 60 days of invitation
steps_tr: Dil sınavına girin (IELTS, CELPIP veya PTE Core)
Davetiyeden sonra 60 gün içinde tam PR başvurunuzu yapın
steps_zh: 确定您的国家职业分类（NOC）代码
进行语言测试（IELTS、CELPIP 或 PTE Core）
计算您的 CRS（综合排名系统）分数
向池中提交您的 Express Entry 个人档案
收到邀请后 60 天内提交完整的永久居民（PR）申请

overview: A pathway to permanent residence for skilled foreign workers and international graduates from a Canadian institution who want to work and live in 1 of Canada's 4 Atlantic provinces: New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, Prince Edward Island, or Newfoundland and Labrador. The program helps employers hire qualified candidates for jobs they haven't been able to fill locally.

core_requirements: Must receive a valid job offer from a designated employer in Atlantic Canada.
Must be either a recent graduate of a recognized post-secondary institution in Atlantic Canada OR a skilled worker.
Can be living abroad or in Canada as a temporary resident.
Must have the right level of education for the job offered.
Must prove language abilities by taking an approved test.
Must show proof of funds to support self and family (Exempt if already living and working in Canada with a valid work permit).
Must get a personalized settlement plan from a service provider organization.

exemptions.international_graduates: Do not need qualifying work experience if they are an international student who graduated from a recognized post-secondary institution in Atlantic Canada and lived in an Atlantic province for at least 16 of the 24 months before receiving the credential.
exemptions.healthcare_sector: Work experience in NOC 31201 (licensed practical nurses) and NOC 31301 (registered nurses) can be used for a job offer in NOC 33102 (TEER 3 - Nurse aides, orderlies) and NOC 44101 (TEER 4 - Home support workers, caregivers).

job_offer_criteria: Must be full-time (at least 30 hours a week).
Must be non-seasonal (consistent and paid all year).
Must be for at least 1 year from becoming a permanent resident for TEER 0, 1, 2, 3 offers.
Must be for permanent employment with no set end date for TEER 4 offers.
Must be at the same or higher skill level as the qualifying work experience (unless exempt as a graduate).
The job offer cannot come from a company in which the applicant, spouse, or common-law partner are a majority owner.

portal_upload_pdfs.name: Offer of Employment to a Foreign National under the Atlantic Immigration Program (Must enter 'Permanent' in box 22 for TEER 4)
Statutory Declaration of Common-law Union (Requires hand-signatures and consecutive 1-year joint proof like bank statements, leases, utility bills)
Separation Declaration for Minors Travelling to Canada (Must be signed by hand in front of a notary public if minor travels without both parents)

rules: Every document not in English or French must include a certified translation with the translator's membership number, seal, or stamp.
If a certified translator is unavailable, an affidavit sworn in front of an authorized person is required.
Authorized persons to witness affidavits/certify inside Canada: Notary Public, Commissioner of Oaths, Commissioner of taking affidavits.
Family members and immigration representatives/consultants are strictly FORBIDDEN from translating documents or witnessing affidavits/certifying copies.

alternate_format_request.subject_line: [Format Needed: Braille / Large Print / Paper] - [Application Package Name]
alternate_format_request.instructions: Send a plain email with Requested Format, Application Package, Preferred Language, Delivery Method, Full Name, Email, and Mailing Address. Do not add extra information. Technical issues form dummy data: UCI enter 1111111111, Application number enter 0000000.

designation_criteria: Must not be in violation of the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act or Regulations.
Must be in good standing with employment standards and occupational health and safety legislation.
Cannot recruit workers to establish a pool to be later transferred or contracted out.
Must have been in continuous, active operation under the same management for at least 2 years in 1 of the Atlantic provinces (or show operation in another location with provincial confirmation).
Must work with a settlement service provider organization to help candidates.
Must complete free mandatory onboarding training and free intercultural competency training.

mandatory_training.onboarding: Watch a sent training video covering Canada's immigration system, AIP background, roles, PR/Work permit applications, and integration. Sign up by emailing business legal/operating name, address, and name of individual completing training to the Dedicated Service Channel.
mandatory_training.intercultural_competency: Takes half a day, offered in person or via live webinar. Covers creating welcoming workplaces, newcomer experiences, and cultural awareness. Targets hiring managers.

endorsement_phase: A designated AIP employer offers you a valid full-time, non-seasonal job.
The candidate connects with an authorized settlement service provider to get a customized Settlement Plan.
Candidate sends the finalized settlement plan back to the designated employer.
The employer submits a formal endorsement application to the respective provincial department (No LMIA required).
The candidate receives a official Provincial Endorsement Certificate and a temporary work permit support letter (if required).
immigration_phase: Submit the official Permanent Residence (PR) application along with the Endorsement Certificate, IMM 0155 checklist, and supporting docs via the online PR Portal.
IRCC reviews, performs background/security checks, and processes the PR application.
Optional: Apply online for a 2-year employer-specific temporary work permit using the provincial referral letter while PR is processing to begin working early.
Complete biometrics within 30 days of receiving the IRCC instruction letter, and book the mandatory medical exam.
Upon final approval, travel to Atlantic Canada to live and work with ongoing support from the employer and settlement provider.

overview: A pathway to permanent residence for skilled foreign workers and international graduates from a Canadian institution who want to work and live in 1 of Canada's 4 Atlantic provinces: New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, Prince Edward Island, or Newfoundland and Labrador. The program helps employers hire qualified candidates for jobs they haven't been able to fill locally.

core_requirements: Must receive a valid job offer from a designated employer in Atlantic Canada.
Must be either a recent graduate of a recognized post-secondary institution in Atlantic Canada OR a skilled worker.
Can be living abroad or in Canada as a temporary resident.
Must have the right level of education for the job offered.
Must prove language abilities by taking an approved test.
Must show proof of funds to support self and family (Exempt if already living and working in Canada with a valid work permit).
Must get a personalized settlement plan from a service provider organization.

exemptions.international_graduates: Do not need qualifying work experience if they are an international student who graduated from a recognized post-secondary institution in Atlantic Canada and lived in an Atlantic province for at least 16 of the 24 months before receiving the credential.
exemptions.healthcare_sector: Work experience in NOC 31201 (licensed practical nurses) and NOC 31301 (registered nurses) can be used for a job offer in NOC 33102 (TEER 3 - Nurse aides, orderlies) and NOC 44101 (TEER 4 - Home support workers, caregivers).

job_offer_criteria: Must be full-time (at least 30 hours a week).
Must be non-seasonal (consistent and paid all year).
Must be for at least 1 year from becoming a permanent resident for TEER 0, 1, 2, 3 offers.
Must be for permanent employment with no set end date for TEER 4 offers.
Must be at the same or higher skill level as the qualifying work experience (unless exempt as a graduate).
The job offer cannot come from a company in which the applicant, spouse, or common-law partner are a majority owner.

portal_upload_pdfs.name: Offer of Employment to a Foreign National under the Atlantic Immigration Program (Must enter 'Permanent' in box 22 for TEER 4)
Statutory Declaration of Common-law Union (Requires hand-signatures and consecutive 1-year joint proof like bank statements, leases, utility bills)
Separation Declaration for Minors Travelling to Canada (Must be signed by hand in front of a notary public if minor travels without both parents)

rules: Every document not in English or French must include a certified translation with the translator's membership number, seal, or stamp.
If a certified translator is unavailable, an affidavit sworn in front of an authorized person is required.
Authorized persons to witness affidavits/certify inside Canada: Notary Public, Commissioner of Oaths, Commissioner of taking affidavits.
Family members and immigration representatives/consultants are strictly FORBIDDEN from translating documents or witnessing affidavits/certifying copies.

alternate_format_request.subject_line: [Format Needed: Braille / Large Print / Paper] - [Application Package Name]
alternate_format_request.instructions: Send a plain email with Requested Format, Application Package, Preferred Language, Delivery Method, Full Name, Email, and Mailing Address. Do not add extra information. Technical issues form dummy data: UCI enter 1111111111, Application number enter 0000000.

designation_criteria: Must not be in violation of the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act or Regulations.
Must be in good standing with employment standards and occupational health and safety legislation.
Cannot recruit workers to establish a pool to be later transferred or contracted out.
Must have been in continuous, active operation under the same management for at least 2 years in 1 of the Atlantic provinces (or show operation in another location with provincial confirmation).
Must work with a settlement service provider organization to help candidates.
Must complete free mandatory onboarding training and free intercultural competency training.

mandatory_training.onboarding: Watch a sent training video covering Canada's immigration system, AIP background, roles, PR/Work permit applications, and integration. Sign up by emailing business legal/operating name, address, and name of individual completing training to the Dedicated Service Channel.
mandatory_training.intercultural_competency: Takes half a day, offered in person or via live webinar. Covers creating welcoming workplaces, newcomer experiences, and cultural awareness. Targets hiring managers.

fees: Sponsor a spouse or partner: from $1,260 (Increased April 30, 2026) | Sponsor a child: from $180 (Increased April 30, 2026)
processing_time: Varies by complexity (Check tracker after receiving AOR)
overview: A comprehensive program to sponsor your spouse, common-law partner, conjugal partner or dependent child to become a permanent resident of Canada. Sponsors must commit to financially supporting the sponsored individuals so they do not require social assistance from the government.

sponsorship_undertaking.definition: A binding contract where the sponsor commits to financially support the sponsored people starting when they become permanent residents. If they receive social assistance, the sponsor must repay the government in full before sponsoring anyone else. Undertaking CANNOT be cancelled or shortened even if citizenship is gained, financial problems arise, or the relationship ends.

durations_outside_quebec.person: Spouse, common-law partner or conjugal partner
Dependent child 22 years of age and older
Dependent child under 22 years of age
durations_outside_quebec.length: 10 years or until the child becomes 25 years of age, whichever comes first (age measured on date they become PR)

sponsorship_undertaking.quebec_rule: Sponsors living in Quebec must sign a separate undertaking with the Government of Quebec. Do not submit the application to Quebec until instructed by IRCC, otherwise it will not be processed.

positive_criteria: Must be at least 18 years old.
Must be a Canadian citizen, a permanent resident of Canada, or a person registered under the Canadian Indian Act.
Must live in Canada (Canadian citizens living outside Canada must show plans to live in Canada when the sponsored person becomes PR; Permanent residents living outside Canada CANNOT sponsor).
Must commit to supporting the people by signing the undertaking and sponsorship agreement.
sponsor_eligibility.income_requirement: In most cases, there is no income requirement to sponsor a spouse, partner, or child. Income proof via Financial Evaluation Form (IMM 1283) is ONLY required if: 1) You are sponsoring a dependent child who has 1 or more dependent children of their own, OR 2) You are sponsoring a spouse/partner who has a dependent child, and that child has 1 or more dependent children of their own.
negative_criteria: Were sponsored by a spouse/partner and became a PR less than 5 years ago.
Sponsored a previous spouse/partner and less than 3 years have passed since they became a PR.
Have an active, undecided sponsorship application for the same person.
Are in jail, prison, or a penitentiary.
Are behind on payments for an immigration loan, a performance bond, or court-ordered family support payments like alimony or child support (Quebec exceptions apply).
Failed to give agreed financial support for a previous sponsorship in the past (Quebec exceptions apply).
Declared bankruptcy and are not discharged yet (Quebec exceptions apply).
Are receiving social assistance for a reason other than a disability.
Were convicted of a violent criminal offence, an offence against a relative causing bodily harm, or a sexual offence inside or outside Canada.
Are under a removal order and cannot legally stay in Canada.

spouse.definition: Legally married to the sponsor, at least 18 years old, can be any gender, must be in a genuine relationship not solely for permanent residence, must not be inadmissible.

common_law_partner.definition: Not legally married, at least 18 years old, can be any gender, in a genuine relationship, must have lived together continuously for at least 12 consecutive months without long periods apart (short family or business trips allowed). Relationship is legally over if either party chooses to end it.

conjugal_partner.definition: Not legally married or common-law, at least 18 years old, can be any gender, in an exclusive and mutually interdependent relationship for at least 1 year (sharing life physically, emotionally, financially, socially). Must live OUTSIDE Canada and be unable to live together or marry due to legal/social/cultural/religious barriers (e.g., divorce banned, same-sex marriage illegal, or religious persecution).

dependent_child.definition: Biological or adopted child of the sponsor or spouse/partner. Must be under 22 years old and have no spouse or common-law partner. If 22 or older, they qualify ONLY if unable to financially support themselves due to a mental or physical condition AND have depended on parents for support since before age 22. Must meet these rules until processing completes.
custody_and_declaration_rules: If sponsoring a child alone without a spouse, the child is the principal applicant. Must provide proof that the other parent/guardian agrees to the immigration.
If a child has a child of their own (grandchild), the grandchild MUST be declared as a dependant, whether coming to Canada or not.

Sponsors must declare ALL children in existence, even those in the sole custody of an ex-spouse where no custody or responsibility remains. They must pass medical and background checks. Failure to declare any family member risks total loss of PR status.
Canadian citizens born abroad cannot be sponsored for PR if they are already citizens by descent; check citizenship status first.

how_to_apply_steps: Create an account or sign in to the online Permanent Residence (PR) Portal.

Understand that there are 2 concurrent applications: the Sponsorship Application (by the sponsor) and the Permanent Residence Application (by the principal applicant). Both must be submitted together online by the principal applicant.
Get country-specific forms and instructions based on where the sponsored person lives, along with the Document Checklist.
Scan and upload both sides of 1 photo for the principal applicant and each family member, adhering strictly to online specifications (not older than 12 months).

Pay all application fees online (Sponsor fee, principal applicant processing fee, Right of Permanent Residence Fee, and Biometrics fee) and upload the receipt. Optional third-party fees apply for medicals and police checks.
Review all digital forms for complete and truthful answers. The principal applicant must electronically sign the application by typing their full name exactly as shown in the passport.
Submit the completed application. If incomplete or missing fees, the application will be rejected and returned for resubmission.

portal_upload_forms.name: Document Checklist tailored to applicant's region
Sponsorship Agreement and Undertaking form specifying everyday and health needs (Not signed by children under 22)

Use of a Representative (Required if using a paid/unpaid representative. Paid must be authorized. Representatives cannot sign or open portals for the applicant; applicant must type their own name for legal signature)
Authority to Release Personal Information to a Designated Individual (Required if releasing info to a non-representative)
Statutory Declaration of Common-law Union (Required for common-law couples, must be hand-signed with 1-year joint proof like bank statements, leases, utility bills)

Separation Declaration for Minors Travelling to Canada (Required if a minor child travels without both parents; must be hand-signed by non-accompanying parent before a notary public. Exempt if sole custody court order or death certificate is provided)

eligibility_criteria: Must be a spouse, common-law partner, or conjugal partner living in Canada who is being sponsored for permanent residence, OR an accompanying dependent child.
Must be living in Canada with the sponsor in a genuine relationship.
Must have received an official Acknowledgement of Receipt (AOR) letter from IRCC confirming the PR application is currently in progress.
Must hold valid temporary resident status (valid visitor record, work permit, study permit, temporary resident permit, or have maintained status/applied for restoration).
ineligibility: Cannot apply if the PR application has been refused, withdrawn, or returned.
Cannot apply for this specific open work permit at a port of entry (must apply online).
open_work_permit_policy.visitor_visa_acceleration: Spouses or partners outside Canada can apply for a visitor visa while waiting. If they have the PR AOR letter, their visitor visa application is eligible for faster automated/electronic processing to help them join their sponsor in Canada early.

processing_mechanisms: IRCC may use electronic methods, automated systems, and computer analytics to help process applications, manage risk, and evaluate compliance using personal data.
Upon complete review, IRCC sends the application number and AOR, and triggers mandatory biometrics instructions (30 days deadline to visit an in-person collection site) and medical exams.
If living in Quebec, the PR application remains in inventory until the MIFI undertaking is secured; PR cannot be finalized without it.
approval_and_refusal_outcomes: If the sponsor is approved, IRCC moves to evaluate the applicant. If the sponsor is refused, the application proceeds or withdraws based on the initial check-box choice (Withdrawal refunds PR fees but forfeits the sponsorship fee; Continuing gives no refunds and zero approval guarantees).
Upon final PR approval for outside-Canada applicants: Confirmation of Permanent Residence (COPR) and a PR visa stamp are issued. Must enter Canada before the document expiry date shown.
Upon final PR approval for inside-Canada applicants: Status is confirmed online via the PR Portal, or an in-person interview is scheduled.
Refusal of inside-Canada class applications (spouse or common-law partner in Canada class) CANNOT be appealed.
withdrawal_and_refunds: Sponsorship can be withdrawn at any time before the applicant officially becomes a PR via the IRCC web form (requires full name, DOB, country of birth, application number, UCI, and signed withdrawal request letter).
Right of Permanent Residence Fee is refundable if withdrawn or refused (requires declining right of appeal first; processes in 2-8 weeks).

alternate_format_and_technical.technical_dummy_data: If facing portal issues on the web form, enter 1111111111 for UCI and 0000000 for Application number if not yet assigned. Upload full screenshots showing error messages.

fees: Work Permit fees vary; LMIA processing fees apply per application.
processing_time: Varies by LMIA approval and work permit stream.
overview: Federal caregiver pilot programs (Home Child Care Provider/Support Worker) are CLOSED as of June 2024. New caregivers must now enter through the Temporary Foreign Worker Program (TFWP) with a positive Labour Market Impact Assessment (LMIA).

who_can_apply: Outside Canada: Only if working in Quebec.
Inside Canada: If you have a valid study/work permit OR are allowed to work without a permit.
Quebec-bound workers may apply from inside Canada if eligible.
who_cannot_apply: Applying at a port of entry.
Currently in Canada as a visitor (with limited exceptions).

employer_lmia_process.recruitment: Employer must advertise the position for 4 weeks (high-wage) or 8 weeks (low-wage) to prove no Canadians are available.
employer_lmia_process.application_method: Must use 'LMIA Online' with a Job Bank for Employers account.
employer_lmia_process.quebec_specific: Must file simultaneously with MIFI (CAQ) and Service Canada (LMIA) for periods over 30 days.

proof_of_experience_submission.scope: Only for those who already submitted applications to the now-closed pilots.
documentation: Schedule 19b: Home Child Care Provider or Home Support Worker – Work Experience form [IMM 5910].
T4 tax slips and Notice of Assessment (NOA) (Must mask SIN).
Detailed Reference Letters: Start/end dates, NOC code, duties, salary/hours, employer contact/signature/letterhead.
Proof of payment: Bank deposits, pay stubs, work contracts, ROEs.
proof_of_experience_submission.submission_protocol: Must be sent via Web Form. Naming convention: 'Proof of experience - #'. Max size 2MB per file (3.5MB total). Use E-number (not W-number) for PR applications.
